# Mono 6.8.0.105 for UWP (Windows Store / WinRT target)

Builds the stock Mono runtime as a static library for the UWP app
container, so the embedded-Mono Celeste path (Path B step 5) can ship on
the Xbox Series S. The Linux harness already embeds Mono 6.8.0.105
(`third_party/mono/`); this is the same runtime, compiled for WinRT.

## How it works

Stock Mono 6.8 has no `--enable-uwp` configure flag — but its Windows
code is written against the WINAPI-family abstraction, and it builds for
the APP partition with two ingredients:

1. `WINAPI_FAMILY=WINAPI_FAMILY_APP` (set by the uwp-crossbuild wrapper's
   `--uwp` flag, same as Visual Studio UWP). `msvc/msvc-win32-support.h`
   then defines `HAVE_UWP_WINAPI_SUPPORT=1` /
   `HAVE_CLASSIC_WINAPI_SUPPORT=0`, and 29 runtime files switch to their
   UWP code paths: `LoadPackagedLibrary` instead of `LoadLibrary`
   (`mono/utils/mono-dl-windows.c`), BCrypt instead of CryptoAPI, no
   console/registry/toolhelp use. The UWP gating is incomplete in
   stock 6.8, though: ~50 functions are classic-gated while their
   callers (mostly the icall table, `icall-def.h`) are not, so the
   first two UWP links failed — patches 11–22 (round 1) and 23–27
   (round 2) stub, unguard, or correct the availability of each one
   (see `patches/README.md`).
2. `-DHAVE_EXTERN_DEFINED_WINAPI_SUPPORT` — Mono's own opt-in for the APP
   partition; the header `#error`s without it under UWP.

The build is the MSVC static-libmono configuration (Release|x64, SGen),
driven by `build-mono-uwp.sh` through the uwp-crossbuild clang-cl wrapper
instead of MSBuild: 294 C sources (`mono-sources.txt` — 293 from the
stock `.targets` files plus `console-null.c`, a UWP-only addition: the
ConsoleDriver icalls in `console-win32.c` are all classic-gated, so
the null console driver provides them), `/MT`, `/O2`,
`config.h` generated from `winconfig.h` exactly the way
`mono.winconfig.targets` does it, `cpu-amd64.h` generated by
`genmdesc.py`, `version.h` written the MSVC way. The SGen GC defines
(`HAVE_SGEN_GC` et al.) go to libmonoruntime and libgcmonosgen, as in
the MSVC solution (`sgen-gc.c` is entirely gated on `HAVE_SGEN_GC` —
without them the GC library compiles empty); they must not leak into
libmini (`mini.h` forbids it). Two x64 functions live in `asm/win64.S`,
a GNU as translation of Mono's `mono/utils/win64.asm` (MASM, git only —
not in the tarball): `mono_context_get_current` and
`copy_stack_data_internal_win32_wrapper` (the cooperative-GC-suspend
register capture, which cannot be written in C). It is assembled with
clang-cl and merged into the archive; its instruction stream was
verified by disassembly.

## What is (and is not) built

- Built: eglib + libmini (including the interpreter,
  `mono/mini/interp/`) + libmonoruntime + libmonoutils + libgcmonosgen
  (SGen) + zlib. The interpreter is selected at runtime with
  `--interpreter` before `mono_jit_init`; the UWP branch of
  `src/trt/mono_host.cpp` forces it (no JIT code executes on the console).
- Not built: the class libraries (the 4.5 profile framework assemblies
  are platform-independent IL — `tools/build-host.sh` packages the same
  6.8.0.105 assemblies the Linux path uses), BTLS, LLVM, the log
  profiler, MonoPosixHelper, the `mono` CLI driver. None of these is
  needed to embed the runtime and run a managed game.

## Provenance and license

- Runtime source: the official release tarball
  `mono-6.8.0.105.tar.xz` from download.mono-project.com, fetched at
  build time into `~/.cache/tiramisu/mono-uwp` and verified against a
  pinned SHA-256 (see `build-mono-uwp.sh`). Only the runtime subset is
  extracted (`mono/`, `support/`, `msvc/`, `winconfig.h`,
  `configure.ac`, `LICENSE`).
- `msvc/msvc-win32-support.h`, `msvc/msvc-disabled-warnings.h`: vendored
  from the mono/mono repo at tag `mono-6.8.0.105` — the release tarball
  omits them (they live in git, not in `make dist`), and `winconfig.h`
  includes them. MIT, same as the rest of Mono.
- `mono-sources.txt`: the Windows x64 SGen source list, derived from the
  stock 6.8 `.targets` files by `dev/parse_targets.py` (run it against a
  checkout of mono/mono at tag `mono-6.8.0.105` to regenerate), plus
  `console-null.c` (a UWP-only addition, documented in the file).
- `asm/win64.S`: a mechanical GNU as translation of mono/mono's
  `mono/utils/win64.asm` at tag `mono-6.8.0.105` (MIT) — see its
  header. The upstream file is MASM and not in the release tarball;
  clang-cl cannot assemble MASM, so the translation is vendored and
  assembled by `build-mono-uwp.sh`.
- Mono is MIT-licensed (see the `LICENSE` file extracted with the
  source). Patch 02's TEB fallback typedef is copied verbatim from the
  Unity mono fork (Unity-Technologies/mono, `mono/utils/mono-tls.h`),
  also MIT. The `NotSupported` stubs in patches 11–15 follow Mono's own
  unsupported-API idiom (`g_unsupported_api` + `mono_error_set_not_-
  supported`, a stock 6.8 pattern also used by Unity-Technologies/mono);
  they were written fresh for stock 6.8's signatures, not copied. No
  other Unity-fork code is used: stock 6.8 already carries the UWP
  gating, and its 6.8.0.105 framework assemblies match the Linux path
  exactly (Unity's fork would need Unity's own class libraries).

## Layout

- `build-mono-uwp.sh` — the build; prints the library path on stdout.
- `mono-sources.txt` — `<lib>\t<repo-relative path>` source list.
- `msvc/` — the two vendored headers (see above).
- `include/` — SDK header case shims (`SDKDDKVer.h`, `MSWSock.h`): the
  xwin splat lowercases those filenames while Mono includes them with
  canonical Windows casing. One-line forwards, no behaviour change.
- `patches/` — 27 UWP patches applied to the fresh extraction, in
  sorted order, before `config.h` generation (see `patches/README.md`):
  a TEB fallback for the empty UWP `winternl.h`, `CreateFileFromAppW`
  in place of the desktop-gated `CreateFileW`/`CreateFileA`, a
  FileVersionInfo guard, no vectored exception handler, a
  `LoadPackagedLibrary` argument fix, `NotSupported` stubs for the
  desktop-only icalls the link needs, unguarded functions whose Win32
  APIs are in fact APP-available, corrected `w32subset.h`
  availability macros, a real UWP `MonoLoadImage` (assembly loading
  needs it), UWP stubs for the ntdll CLR-hosting entry points and
  the stat profiler, and an `<intrin.h>` include plus a clang-only
  inline-asm replacement for `__writegsdword` (clang has no builtin
  for it) in `mono-error-internals.h`.
  Every patch is family-gated so the desktop build is unchanged.
- `asm/win64.S` — the GNU as translation of Mono's `mono/utils/win64.asm`
  (see above), assembled by `build-mono-uwp.sh` and merged into the
  archive.
- `dev/parse_targets.py` — regenerates `mono-sources.txt` from the
  stock `.targets` files.

## Rebuilding

```sh
third_party/mono-uwp/build-mono-uwp.sh            # cached; no-op if current
MONO_UWP_REBUILD=1 third_party/mono-uwp/build-mono-uwp.sh   # force rebuild
```

`tools/build-host.sh` calls this script and links the resulting
`libmonosgen-uwp.lib` into `tiramisu.exe`, then checks the embedding
symbols are present in the image.

## Status: console-verification-pending

This produces a genuinely buildable and linkable UWP Mono (the link
check in `build-host.sh` proves the symbols resolve in the exe). Whether
Celeste runs under it on the Series S can only be proven by a console
test — no UWP runtime exists on Linux. Known next gaps after this step
(not Mono's): FAudio is not compiled into the host yet (FNA's audio
P/Invokes have no UWP target), and the FNA managed DLLs must be
transferred into the game's directory on the console.
